name: Mall Ceiling Perimeter Infill
summary: An 800 mm-deep suspended ceiling cassette closes a 2 m corridor beside the original 1.2 m ceiling module.
description: Two standard 600 mm bays continue the existing ceiling rhythm. The final 200 mm field meets the wall with a finished ivory rail. Four removable fibre panels, nine T-rails and four steel hanger assemblies remain individually editable.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Adapted the original project-owned 1.2 m cassette in Blender. The short panels and cross rails are cut in local mesh coordinates to preserve the real T sections, panel bevels and fibre texture density.

dimensions.axis_order: glTF X, Y, Z in metres
dimensions.datum: Grid underside Y=0; legacy cassette at -Z, perimeter wall at +Z.

attribution.credit: Original geometry, materials and packed mineral-fibre artwork from the Blender-3D-Gallery mall ceiling panel. Perimeter adaptation and thumbnail produced for the same project.

rights: Owner-project reuse of the original assets and adaptation is authorized. Public download and redistribution terms are unspecified.
accuracy_notes: Decorative ceiling geometry. Mounting checks establish mesh contact and clearance in the gallery assembly. No structural, acoustic, fire or electrical performance has been assessed.
